method: Independent PyMuPDF glyph-position extraction groups numeric page cells by printed row baseline, including rotated publisher grids. Each table uses numeric row FNV-1a 32-bit signatures (integer hundredths with null=x), followed by a sorted multiset fingerprint. This tests that the entire numerical matrix can be accounted for, not paired row identities and not source facts.
scope: 63/63 tables inspected and classified, not 63/63 approved. 22 earlier tables have stronger source row-label verification as recorded in independent-audit ledger.
limits: An exact multiset verifies values but not whether the values are assigned to the right commodity or province. Do not treat a hash match as complete visual label validation.
Layout exceptions are never coerced to success. Publisher transcriptions are maintained separately and 2,163 semantic rows still match their saved source transcripts.
This audit is a reproducible numeric cross-check against the original 89-page upload; not proof that the publisher's reported statistics are correct.
FNV32 signatures are fast integrity checks, not cryptographic provenance authentication. Verify original PDF digest and original coordinates for high-stakes decisions.
Interpret dates and units at each table; August vs July 2026 data must not be merged as equivalent observations.
